questions: How many oxidized or etched CsV3Sb5 devices did you make, and how many showed a field-free diode? Your p. 4 and Table S1 cover ten pristine devices, all diode-free, and Devices 11 to 14 show the effect; the total number of inversion-broken devices isn't stated.
Why were any others set aside?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown, in particular out-of-plane fields between 0 and 0.1 T, other sweep rates, and the temperatures of Fig. 4 and of the Ti-doped devices?
What does the second-best dataset look like, for example the third oxidation stage of the Fig. 2 device, where you write "none of which showed SDE" (SI p. 2)?

What was the residual out-of-plane field at the sample during the "B = 0" sweeps, after the ±10 T magnetoresistance sweeps of Figs. S1 and S2 and the 1 T field cooling of Figs. S8 and S9, and was it measured or nulled?

With many sweeps per direction at zero field (a few hundred, say), how do the switching-current histograms for positive and negative bias compare, and is the mean η different from zero? In Fig. S7 both |Ic+| and |Ic−| move by a few μA between sweeps, about the size of their difference.

For the Ti-doped controls (Devices 15 and 16), at what temperature and T/Tc were they measured, how many sweeps per condition did you take, and did Device 16 get the same etch pattern as Device 13? Since the Fig. 2 device showed a diode in one of three sweeps per oxidation stage, how many diode-free sweeps would you need before the null is clear?
